shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat upright slab (stela/panel format)
rectangular framed field with register divisions
human/anthropomorphic profile elements (figures in A; profile faces within glyphs in B)
justification: Both are upright relief-carved slabs bearing script signs arranged in horizontal registers, and both include profile anthropomorphic heads, but these are broadly generic monumental conventions. A shows a figural scene—two standing figures facing each other, one holding a staff, beneath an arched winged/celestial canopy with a disc, with only a small caption of signs—whereas B is an entirely textual grid of blocky glyph cartouches with no scene, no standing figures, and no arched frame.
